en: Spring tides swell the river to meet the sea
and with them the bright moon rises
Its light rides the waves ten thousand miles
Where on the spring river is no moonlight?
The river winds around the fragrant meadows
Moonlit blossoms glitter like sleet
Frost seems to drift unseen through the air
the white sands of the shore fade from sight
River and sky, one color, without a speck
Bright in the void hangs a lonely moon
Who on this shore first saw the moon?
When did the moon first shine on us?
Generation after generation, life goes on
Year after year, the moon looks the same
Who is the moon waiting for?
Only the long river, carrying water away
A white cloud drifts slowly away
Sorrow fills the green maple shore
Whose skiff is out on the river tonight?
Where is the moonlit tower of longing?
Alas, the moon lingers over the tower
shining on the mirror of one left behind
Rolled in the curtain, it will not go
brushed from the anvil, it comes back
Sharing one moon, we cannot hear each other
I'd follow the moonbeams to shine on you
Geese fly far, yet can't outfly the light
Fish leap from the deep, writing on the water
Last night I dreamt of petals on a quiet pool
Spring is half gone, and still no way home
The river carries spring nearly away
and over the pool the moon sinks west again
The slanting moon sinks into the sea mist
Endless roads from Jieshi to Xiaoxiang
How many ride the moonlight home?
The sinking moon fills the trees with longing
